{{- /* The page's canonical URL, after the pre-reorg theme's meta-version.html: a page in an archived version (any [[params.versions]] entry past the first params.activeVersions) points at its counterpart in the newest active version; everything else points at itself. Archived copies keep the flat pre-reorg tree, so the counterpart is looked up as a real page first (same path) and then through the redirect map the reorganized pages declare in `aliases` (the same map index.redir turns into 301s), so the URL names a page that answers 200. A dropped page with no counterpart keeps its own URL rather than pointing at a 404. Returned as a string: head.html prints the and reuses it for og:url, so the social card names the same page the link does. */ -}} {{- $canonical := .Permalink -}} {{- $versions := site.Params.versions -}} {{- $active := site.Params.activeVersions | default 1 -}} {{- if and $versions .Section -}} {{- if where (after $active $versions) "dirpath" .Section -}} {{- $target := index $versions (sub $active 1) -}} {{- $rest := strings.TrimPrefix (printf "/%s" .Section) .Path -}} {{- with site.GetPage (printf "/%s%s" $target.dirpath $rest) -}} {{- $canonical = .Permalink -}} {{- else -}} {{- $map := partialCached "canonical-alias-map.html" $target.dirpath $target.dirpath -}} {{- with index $map (printf "/%s%s/" $target.dirpath $rest) -}}{{ $canonical = . }}{{- end -}} {{- end -}} {{- end -}} {{- end -}} {{- return $canonical -}}
